purpose: Non-admission source discovery of original agricultural parcel and physical infrastructure inventories surfaced by Exa research on 2026-11-05. Candidate records only; no original assets, insurer locations, rights approvals, or model admission.

entries.name: JRC EuroCropsV2 harmonised EU agricultural parcel crop declarations
entries.provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre / EUROSTAT / national agricultural paying agencies
entries.spatial_scope: Available regional coverage across participating European countries; not uniformly complete at country/region/year level
entries.temporal_scope: National source vintages from 2008 through 2023 where available; JRC EuroCropsV2 published 2025 and corrected in 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Harmonised parcel-level GeoParquet geometries (EPSG:3035), crop identifiers and harmonised HCAT4 mapping; nearly 47 million parcels reported in project documentation, across multiple non-uniform vintages
entries.note: Original JRC distribution https://jeodpp.jrc.ec.europa.eu/ftp/jrc-opendata/DRLL/EuroCropsV2/ and 2026-03-05 copyright.txt declare EU CC BY 4.0 with attribution/change indication. Original repo https://github.com/Martincccc/EuroCropsV2 documents corrected gpqtv201 (stack) and gpqtv202 (overlapping polygons) versions; pin exact selected file, version, SHA256, geometry validity, CRS, codebook and source national usage rights before admission. National farmer declarations are self-reported, not observed plant cover, insured crop values, policy holdings or loss observations. EuroCropsV2 includes national paying-agency inputs (including Netherlands); never treat it as independent of Dutch BRP when the underlying parcel/source vintage overlaps.

entries.name: Netherlands RVO/PDOK Basisregistratie Gewaspercelen (BRP) agricultural parcels
entries.spatial_scope: Netherlands, annual agricultural/landscape parcels as filed by participating land users; not every insured farm or field
entries.temporal_scope: Annual observed declaration reference date 15 May; 2025 final dataset supplied 2026-03-17, historical exports exist for earlier years
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Per-parcel geometry with crop category and crop codes, OGC API Features/WFS/WMS/ATOM dataset distribution; current OGC API returns most recent dataset
entries.note: Official PDOK dated 2026-03-17 confirms 2025 final release https://www.pdok.nl/-/brp-gewaspercelen-2025-definitief and native OGC/WFS/ATOM endpoints. Official API advertises Public Domain Mark 1.0, zero charge and no authentication; Public Domain Mark is a copyright status marker, not by itself an independent rights grant or blanket privacy/contract approval. Declaration fields refer to crop filed on reference day 15 May, not confirmed actual growing season or policy-level crop/TIV. Parcel counts include landscape elements; do not equate parcel count with insurable fields. National source can underlie EuroCropsV2; maintain original ID, vintage, downstream provenance and avoid counting correlated evidence twice.

entries.name: GeoMermaids World Infrastructures Dataset (GMWID) global GeoParquet
entries.provider: GeoMermaids / OpenStreetMap contributors / stated authoritative national infrastructure registers
entries.spatial_scope: Worldwide OSM-derived infrastructure plus separately attributed official source enrichments; coverage differs greatly by region and asset class
entries.temporal_scope: Provider advertises weekly rebuilt latest layers; historical snapshot preservation is not guaranteed, source vintages vary by upstream
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 27 infrastructure layers described by provider as per-asset GeoParquet 2.0, including power plants, substations, power lines, telecom masts, pipelines, wells and water infrastructure; origin/source attributes
entries.note: Original provider documents global `gmwid/latest/` GeoParquet under ODbL 1.0, lineage `origin` and coverage receipts, plus per-build https://parquetry.geomermaids.com/gmwid/ATTRIBUTION.txt. National additions include EIA, FCC, Agence ORE and others, which are not statistically independent from matching originals already in OpenCatastrophe. UK NSTA data are in a separate explicitly noncommercial `gmwid/nsta/` scope and must never be silently merged into a commercially reusable file. ODbL attribution/share-alike, third-party restrictions, source family matching, weekly volatility and topology/attribute uncertainties need explicit legal/scientific review. Infrastructure presence is not insured replacement cost or modeled outage/loss.

entries.name: US FCC Antenna Structure Registration (ASR) public database downloads
entries.spatial_scope: United States registered antenna structures, restricted to FCC ASR regulated structures; not all telecom towers or rooftop antennas
entries.temporal_scope: FCC publishes periodic complete and daily transaction download products; state, deletions and historical validity require original schema checks
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Individual ASR registration and application records provided as tabular ZIP extracts, with separate FAA determination records; structure location and attributes may be present and require schema review
entries.note: Original FCC public database pages list ASR application, registration and FAA determination downloads with complete/daily transaction products. Verify a precise FCC-hosted ZIP path, latest source timestamps, registered/deleted flags, coordinate datum and any controlled/personally identifying fields before fetching or storing rows. GMWID explicitly cites FCC ASR for its added US telecom masts, therefore FCC and GMWID assets are not two independent tower observations; do not double count, and do not treat an FCC registration as insured owner, full asset replacement value or measured wind vulnerability.
